pr_body:
createAsyncIterator should throw ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE if 'close' is emitted before 'end'

Closes #39086
pr_comments: It looks like the issue has been closed by another PR.

issue_context.title: Readable[AsyncIterator] doesn't handle premature close
issue_context.body: `createAsyncIterator` should throw `ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE` if `'close'` is emitted before `'end'`. Right now I think it just silently succeeds.

review_comments: Throwing from an async event handler is not a good idea because it can't be caught (aside from the process-wide `'uncaughtException'` event handler).
You don't want to do anything in the event handler here. You should probably look at the finally block.
